export.hint: Secrets are written as secretRef. orbivisorctl apply -f reads this file as it is.

sets.title: Apply sets
sets.emptyHint: Getting started: 1. Get the current settings as files with Export as YAML in a page's ⋯ menu (VMs, networks, …) or orbivisorctl export 2. Keep the files in Git 3. orbivisorctl apply --set name -f folder.
sets.intro: Write settings as YAML files and apply them all at once with orbivisorctl apply. The cluster remembers what was applied and tells you when someone changes it in the UI ("differs from the file"). Not needed if you only use the UI.

set.driftHint_one: {{count}} object differs from its declaration. Apply again to put it back, or accept the actual value as the declaration (then update your files with orbivisorctl export --set).
set.driftHint_other: {{count}} objects differ from their declarations. Apply again to put them back, or accept the actual values as the declarations (then update your files with orbivisorctl export --set).
set.adoptAll: Accept all actual values as declared
set.adopted: Apply set {{name}} now declares the actual values.
set.adoptHint: The apply set then declares what the cluster has now. Nothing in the cluster changes; update your files afterwards with orbivisorctl export --set.
set.adoptItem: {{kind}} {{name}}: its actual values become the declaration
set.adoptMissing: {{kind}} {{name}}: gone from the cluster, so it leaves the apply set
